Operator rule of 2026-10-03: whenever a literature batch completes, the Orchestrator proposes and dispatches the next literature wave on its own, choosing the logic by the scientific priorities that emerge (select with a read-only selector agent; same three tests: abstract substantive, lawful body, a question it could change; breadth over repetition). Emerging priority order: (1) allele-class function actually MEASURED (RNA/protein for splice, missense, deletion alleles) and carrier/heterozygote phenotypes (CLAIM 032/045 are thin); (2) restoration spec: WWOX pharmacodynamic assay first, window by endpoint class, immune cost for predicted-null recipients, neonatal DRG/tolerisation; (3) myelin cell-autonomy beyond the thin O-KO negative; (4) patient-overlap integrity (count once); (5) reading debts named by dossiers (Bouteille 2009, Celebi 2020, Serin 2018, Tabarki 2015, Hordeaux 2019/2020, Finnis 2005, Ko 2018) when lawful text appears; (6) periodic fresh-literature scan (WWOX/WOREE/SCAR12/EIEE28 by date). The neuro-WWOX pool is nearly exhausted: when a wave would have fewer than 12 qualifying studies, say so and shift weight to transferable lessons and debts rather than pad.
